title: Universal H0 splitting factorization data
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sc-universal-h0-split-differential, there are a module I and maps e:P.X 0 -> I, p:I -> P.X 1, r:I -> P.X 0, q:P.X 1 -> I such that d=e p, e r=id, and p q=id.

source.place: Tags 00O0 and 00NX, local matrix splitting and projective cokernel

proof.text: Localize at primes, perform the unit-minor reduction, and identify the cokernel as finite projective. The resulting image and quotient splittings give the displayed factorization and retractions.

lean.statement:
theorem universalH0_split_factorization
    (R : Type v) [CommRing R]
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ)
    (hf0 : Module.Finite R (P.X 0))
    (hf1 : Module.Finite R (P.X 1))
    (hp0 : Module.Projective R (P.X 0))
    (hp1 : Module.Projective R (P.X 1))
    (hneg : IsZero (P.X (-1)))
    (hzero : ∀ (B : Type v) [CommRing B] (φ : R →+* B),
      let PB := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
      Nonempty (PB.homology 0 ≅ ModuleCat.of B B)) :
    ∃ (I : ModuleCat.{v} R) (e : P.X 0 ⟶ I) (p : I ⟶ P.X 1)
      (r : I ⟶ P.X 0) (q : P.X 1 ⟶ I),
      P.d 0 1 = e ≫ p ∧ e ≫ r = 𝟙 (P.X 0) ∧ p ≫ q = 𝟙 I
